cases.input: SELECT customer_id, name, balance FROM customers WHERE balance > 0.0 ORDER BY balance DESC LIMIT 20;

cases.description: Calculate average order amount by customer region
cases.input: SELECT c.region, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_val FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.region LIMIT 50;

cases.description: Count products available per category
cases.input: SELECT category, count(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category LIMIT 50;

cases.description: Lookup single order details by primary key
cases.input: SELECT order_id, customer_id, amount, status, order_date FROM orders WHERE order_id = 101 LIMIT 1;
